notes: Contracts-only Basket Protocol index vault for Stock Tokens on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663). BaskVault is the sole application contract and its own ERC-20 share: Basket (BASK), 18 decimals, zero supply at deployment, no share-supply cap; deposits mint shares and redemptions burn them. Constructor arguments are the brief's literal owner and guardian addresses, in that order. The constructor makes no external calls. The asset list starts empty; the owner lists at least three assets and finalizes genesis once. Deposits become eligible 72 hours later, subject to market, oracle, solvency, NAV-cap and global-bucket checks. These later owner actions are not manifest initialization calls. NAV uses managed balances; direct token transfers do not increase NAV. Deposit and redemption fees are fixed at 0.5%, rounded up. The fee recipient starts unset and the owner may set it once, finally; deposit fee shares are not minted while unset and redemption fee shares are burned. Owner and guardian controls cannot gate redeem or claim. Redemption reads no prices and processes at most 64 assets, using 50,000-gas balance reads and a 250,000-gas self-call per payout. Unreadable balances use managed accounting; failed payouts become owed credits without blocking other legs. Claims retry the exact-debit payout without that per-leg gas cap and remain subject to token transfer success. Accepted design notes: (1) A lagging feed can permit deposit-then-redeem profit when the discrepancy exceeds the 1% round-trip fee. (2) The owner must pair each Stock Token with its true feed. (3) An untransferable asset keeps its feed value until deposits are paused. (4) Retired assets count zero in NAV. (5) There is no per-asset concentration limit; one asset may represent any share of NAV. No separate launch token, pool or website.
